changelog:
Initial release of the freelancer-bidder skill:

- Automatically scans Freelancer.com for projects matching your skills and preferences.
- Drafts personalized, professional bid proposals tailored to each client.
- Tracks your bidding history and win rates in a simple log.
- Recommends optimal bid prices based on project budgets.
- Offers tips for crafting effective, winning proposals.
